#### China Graphite Group Limited

(Stock Code: 2237)

ANNOUNCEMENT OF ANNUAL RESULTS FOR THE YEAR ENDED 31 DECEMBER 2025

The board (the ‘‘Board’’) of directors (the ‘‘Directors’’) of China Graphite Group Limited (the ‘‘Company’’) is pleased to announce the audited consolidated annual results of the Company and its subsidiaries for the year ended 31 December 2025. This announcement, containing the full text of the 2025 annual report of the Company, complies with the applicable requirements of the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (the ‘‘Stock Exchange’’) in relation to information to accompany preliminary announcement of annual results.

Both the Chinese and English versions of this results announcement are available on the website of the Stock Exchange at www.hkexnews.hk and the Company’s website at www.chinagraphite.com.hk.

### FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS

#### KEY FINANCIAL DATA

FY2025 FY2024 Change (%) RMB’000 RMB’000

Sale of spherical graphite and its by-products 28,652 29,436 -2.7% Sale of flake graphite concentrate 109,306 108,966 0.3% Sale of unprocessed marble 14,958 3,969 276.9%

Total revenue 152,916 142,371 7.4%

Gross profit 44,941 41,576 8.1% Gross profit margin 29.4% 29.2% 0.7%

Net profit/(loss) 4,905 (12,501) 139.2% Net profit/(loss) margin 3.2% (8.8%) 136.4%

• In FY2025, the natural graphite market was in a period of stabilisation at cyclical lows, with little change in demand or pricing from FY2024. Revenue amounted to approximately RMB152.9 million for FY2025 compared to approximately RMB142.4 million for FY2024, increased by approximately 7.4% year-on-year; 

• Revenue from the sale of spherical graphite and its by-products amounted to approximately RMB28.7 million for FY2025 compared to approximately RMB29.4 million for FY2024, down by approximately 2.7% year-on-year;

• Revenue from the sale of flake graphite concentrate amounted to approximately RMB109.3 million for FY2025 compared to approximately RMB109.0 million for FY2024, increased by approximately 0.3% year-on-year;

• Revenue from the sale of unprocessed marble amounted to approximately RMB15.0 million for FY2025 compared to approximately RMB4.0 million for FY2024, increased by approximately 276.9% year-on-year, primarily driven by increased extraction volumes of unprocessed marble and the successful securing of sales contracts during the year; 
• Gross profit amounted to approximately RMB44.9 million for FY2025 compared to approximately RMB41.6 million for FY2024, increased by approximately 8.1% year-on-year. Gross profit margin increased to 29.4% for FY2025 from 29.2% for FY2024; 

• Net profit amounted to approximately RMB4.9 million for FY2025 compared to net loss of approximately RMB12.5 million for FY2024; and

• The Directors do not recommend the payment of a final dividend for FY2025 (FY2024: Nil).
